notes:
Background: Fieldline builds outbound chat assistants that live inside sales reps' workflows (Gmail/Calendar/CRM). Looking for hosted API to validate UX and latency then move to Dedicated for predictable capacity and data isolation.

Key quotes from kickoff: "Streaming must feel live — sub-200ms perceived reply latency; tool calls must be atomic and idempotent". Reps expect immediate typing/streaming and quick CRM writebacks (create lead, log email, schedule meeting).

Security: SOC2 posture required, SSO via SAML, encryption keys managed by customer KMS for Dedicated. Data residency: primary US, option to lock EEA data in EU for later release.

POC ask: 3-week trial (hosted) to validate streaming latency with 50-100 concurrent agents, then price Dedicated baseline for 24/7 pool (peak 100 concurrent). Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay premium for reliable <200ms streaming and tool reliability.

CRM notes: heavy reliance on deterministic tool-calling (retry semantics). Must map user intent -> tool call -> confirmation message in stream. Prefers Redwood routing/fallbacks to keep UI responsive when primary model overloaded.

Internal owners: Product (CTO lead) driving decision; Sales Ops and Security closely involved. AE Jordan Hale running procurement conversations; SE Priya Kapoor running perf tests.

use_case_summary: Outbound SDR/chat agent that streams token-by-token to sales reps; agent performs tool-calls to CRM (create/update lead), send templated emails, and create calendar invites. UX requires streaming feel + inline confirmation for tool actions. Primary goal: increase reply throughput and shorten time-to-first-action while ensuring audit trail and idempotency for CRM writes.
performance_targets: Latency SLO: end-to-end perceived streaming latency <=200ms for token streaming start/continuation under normal load. Tool-call RTT target <=400ms for CRM writes (including retries). Expected concurrency: 50-150 active agents (peak 100). Token-throughput target ~25-40 tps per active session on average.
poc_plan: Week 1: Hosted API integration + core streaming flow + tool-calling mock (CRM sandbox)
Week 2: Stress tests (50 -> 150 concurrent agents), measure tail latencies and cold-start behavior
Week 3: Security checklist validation, KMS demo for key access, prepare Dedicated sizing estimate
Post-POC: Pricing workshop and Dedicated sizing, legal/data residency addendum
pricing_notes: Fieldline expects detailed committed-capacity pricing for Dedicated. Interested in burst pricing and overage math. Wants per-concurrent-agent and per-token breakdown, with example cost for 100 concurrent agents at 8-hour peak window. Asking for draft TCO comparison Hosted vs Dedicated over 12 months.
decision_criteria: Meets streaming latency SLOs consistently (p99 under load)
Reliable, auditable tool-calling with retry/idempotency guarantees
Transparent cost model and a clear committed capacity option
Security posture (SAML, KMS, audit logs) and data residency controls
